entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so sad about it. I think I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with it. I can certainly look into the return options for you. First, could I get your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Anna Garcia, order number VF77819-P. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for this, but... it's just not working for me.
Thank you, Anna. I see your order here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so confusing. I've read the user manual twice, but the whole interface is really hard to use. Honestly, I just expected more, you know? It feels like a step back.
I see. Sometimes new interfaces can take a little getting used to. Was there a particular feature you were trying to access?

It's a bit of everything. I just don't have the time to fight with it. I feel awful saying it, but with money being tight, I really needed this purchase to be perfect. I'd just rather have the money back if that's okay.
I completely understand. It's important you're satisfied with your VeloFit products. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility... one moment.
Okay, thank you. I was worried it might be too late.
Alright, Anna, I see the VeloBand was delivered to you 32 days ago. Let me check our policy...
Oh no, is that a problem? I've been such a loyal customer, I was hoping there'd be some flexibility.
No, it's not a problem at all. According to our policy here, all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! You have no idea. So I can send it back for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just place the device back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That was so easy. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

You are very welcome, Anna. We're sorry the product wasn't the right fit this time, but we're happy to make it right. Once we receive the return, your refund will be issued in 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
